method.summary: General computer-use agent (screen in, mouse and keyboard out). Collected 6 blaze rods and 3 ender pearls; stopped after 141 hours without reaching the dragon.
method.interface_zh: 截图 → 键盘鼠标（计算机操作）

notes: Milestones up to smelting iron are claimed because Vals AI’s 3-hour upload shows the agent building a Nether portal, and in practice its obsidian takes iron: a bucket to cast it from lava, or a diamond pickaxe, which needs an iron pickaxe first. The iron pickaxe and diamonds are not claimed, since a bucket is enough. Reported via press, not verified. The 141h time is when the run was stopped, so it is an upper bound for reaching the blaze rods.
